title: Luxury Travel in Costa Rica: The Ultimate 2026 Experience
metaDescription: Indulge in the finest experiences Costa Rica has to offer. Luxury hotels, private tours, and exclusive activities for discerning travelers.
excerpt: Costa Rica offers world-class luxury experiences for travelers who demand the very best. From five-star resorts to private excursions, this is luxury travel at its finest.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
Few places in the world can match the allure of Costa Rica. Whether you are seeking luxury in Costa Rica for the first time or returning for more, there is always something new to discover.

## Luxury Accommodation

- Five-star resorts with private beaches and butler service
- Boutique hotels housed in historic buildings with modern amenities
- Private villas with infinity pools and panoramic views
- Exclusive retreats offering spa treatments and wellness programs

![Luxury in Costa Rica](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1582218290380-ae58573670e3?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Exclusive Experiences

Private guided tours of Costa Rica's most iconic landmarks, away from the crowds and at your own pace.

Luxury car rentals let you explore Costa Rica in style and comfort.
